Add.Description: The Add modifiers are used in a definition to Add an attribute to the Definition.

Parameters.Description: The Add modifiers are used in a definition to Add an attribute to the Definition.

Add.Name: Add

Replace.Description: The Replace modifiers are used in a definition to Replace an attribute to the Definition.

Parameters.Description: The Replace modifiers are used in a definition to Replace an attribute to the Definition.

Replace.Name: Replace

Delete.Description: The Delete modifiers are used in a definition to Delete an attribute to the Definition.

Parameters.Description: The Delete modifiers are used in a definition to Delete an attribute to the Definition.

Delete.Name: Delete

Default.Description: Gives the default value of the variable.

Parameters.Description: To set the default value for the variable.

Default.Name: Default

List Var.Description: Specify a list of either a Simple or Compound Variable.
List Var.Name: List Var

Local.Description: The Local attribute is used in the context of the definition to set local value within the scope of that definition only.

Parameters.Description: The Local attribute is used in the context of the definition to set local value within the scope of that definition only.

Local.Name: Local

Persist.Description: Specifies whether the value of the variable can be persisted/retained across multiple tally instances or not.

Parameters.Description: When it is set to Yes, the variable will retain its value even after exiting tally.(Default value: No)

Persist.Name: Persist

Repeat.Description: Specifies the name of the Collection based on which the variable assumes multiple vales in context of a multi-columnar report.

Parameters.Description: This is an expression which evaluates to a collection name.
This is the name of the method from the collection from which the value is picked up for the variable.

Repeat.Name: Repeat

Set Always.Description: It modifies the value of the variable immediately.

Parameters.Description: It is a logical value which  accepts either Yes or No.

Set Always.Name: Set Always

System Name.Description: Specifies whether sysnames can be stored in the variable.

Parameters.Description: If it is YES the variable can hold a sysname.

System Name.Name: System Name

Table.Description: This attribute overrides the default collection used in the variable.  This attribute is used locally in a report to override the default table for the variable.

Parameters.Description: This is a collection which overrides the default collection for the variable.

Table.Name: Table

Type.Description: Specifies the type of the data held by the variable.

Parameters.Description: It refers to the type of data to be stored in the variable.
Parameters.Keywords: Aggregate, Amount, Date, DateTime, Due Date, Duration, FlagSet, Logical, Long, Number, NumSet, Quantity, Rate, Rate of Exchange, String, Sys Id, Time

Type.Name: Type

Use.Description: The USE keyword is used in a definition to reuse an existing definition.

Parameters.Description: It acts as label for grouping.

Use.Name: Use

Variable.Description: To specify a Simple or Compound Variable within a Variable Definition.
Variable.Name: Variable

Volatile.Description: Specifies whether the value of the variable can retained across multiple scopes.

Parameters.Description: When it is set to Yes, the variable reatins the previous value from the caller scope   in current instance of Tally. (Default value: Yes)

Volatile.Name: Volatile
